interactionSteps.note: Focus stays on the first tab.

assistiveTechnologyTests.procedure: Complete the journey and listen for the announcement or information under test.

title: Tab set ignores the arrow keys
description: Clicking a tab works, but pressing ArrowRight or ArrowLeft on a focused tab does nothing. The beta path moves focus and selection between tabs.

relatedElements.note: The control implements ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, Home and End.

expectedBehaviour: Arrow keys move focus and selection between tabs in a tab list.
actualBehaviour: Arrow keys are ignored; only clicking or tabbing changes the selected tab.
userImpact: Keyboard users must Tab through the tab list and press Enter rather than using the expected arrow keys.

wcag.note: The tabs are still keyboard operable with Tab and Enter. The missing arrow-key model is a best-practice gap, not a keyboard failure.

detection.note: Requires focus and key presses; static markup looks valid.

observed.note: Page-level axe run with tags wcag2a, wcag2aa, wcag21a, wcag21aa and best-practice. No violation was reported in the default state; the control on the same page or path also passes.

manualTests: Focus the first tab, press ArrowRight and check whether focus and selection move.

assertions: ArrowRight leaves focus on the first alpha tab and its panel unchanged.
tests: tests/subtle-widgets.spec.js: keeps alpha arrow navigation missing

reviewStatus.note: A Playwright regression test preserves the defective journey or widget behaviour and its control. That is automated reproduction, not a manual or assistive-technology observation.
